about: About Pandie Foundation
The Mother of All
A humanitarian nonprofit dedicated to protecting and uplifting
vulnerable children in Sierra Leone through education, nutrition,
medical assistance, and compassionate care.
Our Impact
Every Number Is a Child Whose Life Changed
Children Supported
and counting
Active Programs
across Sierra Leone
Countries Reached
USA & Sierra Leone
Donation Transparency
every cent accounted for
"Our mission is simple but urgent:
to ensure that no child is denied the chance to grow, learn, and thrive
simply because they were born into hardship."
This is the conviction that gave birth to Pandie Foundation — and the promise that drives everything we do.
Foundation Founder
Founder & Executive Director
Sierra Leone — United States
A Message From the Founder
I Started This Foundation Because I Witnessed the Suffering Firsthand
Growing up in Sierra Leone, I saw children full of intelligence, creativity,
and dreams — who had no path forward simply because of poverty.
I saw families who loved their children deeply
but could not afford school fees, medicine, or even food.
I carried those faces with me as I built my life.
When I established Pandie Foundation, I named it after my mother,
Pandie Grace Bangura — a woman who gave everything she had
to anyone who needed it, often before she took care of herself.
She taught me that compassion has no limits,
and that a mother's love should extend to every child who needs it.
This foundation is my promise to her — and to every child in Sierra Leone
who deserves the same chance I was given.
I am grateful to every donor, volunteer, and partner
who has chosen to stand with us in this mission.
— Founder & Executive Director
In Honor Of
The heart and soul behind this foundation
The Name Behind the Foundation
A Son's Honor for His Mother's Endless Love
Pandie Grace Bangura is not just a mother to her own children.
She is a mother to everyone around her.
In a community where many have little, she gives freely —
her time, her food, her warmth, her strength, and her compassion.
She sees a hungry child and feeds them.
She never asks what she will receive in return.
Her life of nurturing and generosity inspired the name Pandie,
meaning "The Mother of All."
This foundation was created in her honor and stands as a living continuation
of the compassion she models every single day,
extending her love to every child who needs it.
"She believed that every child mattered — not just her own — and that true kindness is measured by how we care for those who have the least."
— Joseph Allan Kamara, Founder
Our Journey
From a Dream to a Movement
The Beginning
A Vision Is Born
Joseph Allan Kamara, a native of Sierra Leone, witnesses the struggles of vulnerable children and carries a deep conviction that something must be done.
The Inspiration
Named After a Mother
The foundation is named in honor of Pandie Grace Bangura — a woman whose selfless love and compassion for others continue to shape the soul of this mission.
The Foundation
Pandie Foundation Is Established
Pandie Foundation is officially established as a humanitarian nonprofit dedicated to supporting vulnerable children in Sierra Leone through education, nutrition, and medical care.
The Programs
Six Core Programs Launched
Education Support, Nutrition Support, Medical Assistance, Child Protection, Child Sponsorship, and Community Outreach programs are developed and activated.
The Future
Growing Toward Greater Impact
With the support of donors, volunteers, and partners around the world, Pandie Foundation is expanding its reach and building toward a future where no child is left behind.
The Reality We Face
Behind Every Statistic Is a Child With a Name
In many communities across Sierra Leone, children face challenges
that threaten their future from the very beginning.
These are not distant problems — they are happening right now,
to real children with real dreams.
A Child Who Wants to Learn
She wakes before sunrise and walks miles to school,
only to sit in a classroom with no textbooks,
with no guarantee she can return tomorrow
if her family cannot pay the fees.
A Child Who Goes to Bed Hungry
He is nine years old and already knows
what it feels like to concentrate through hunger.
Some days, the only thing between him and an empty stomach
is a single cup of rice.
A Child Who Needs Medical Care
She has had a fever for a week.
Her mother knows what to do but cannot afford the medicine.
She prays and watches and waits —
because the alternative is unthinkable.
These are not distant statistics. These are real children with real dreams.
Their futures hang on whether someone — somewhere — chooses to care.
Pandie Foundation exists to be that someone.
Our Mission
To ensure that no child is denied the chance to grow, learn,
and thrive simply because they were born into hardship.
We provide education, nutrition, medical care, and protection —
treating every child as if they were our own.
Our Vision
A Sierra Leone — and ultimately an Africa —
where no child is forgotten, no child is forced to give up on education,
and every child grows up knowing that their life matters
and their future is worth fighting for.
What We Do
Six Ways We Change a Child's Future
We focus on the essential needs that allow a child not only to survive but to flourish.
Every program we design is guided by one principle: treat each child as if they were our own.
Education Support
School fees, supplies, uniforms, and materials so no child misses out on learning.
Nutrition & Food
Nutritious meals and food assistance so hunger never stands between a child and their future.
Medical Care
Healthcare and medical support for children suffering from preventable and treatable conditions.
Child Protection
Advocacy, safety, and dignity programs for children at risk of neglect and exploitation.
Child Sponsorship
Long-term individual sponsorship connecting generous donors directly with a child's journey.
Community Outreach
Working hand in hand with families, local leaders, and schools to create lasting change.
Explore All Programs
Our Values
What Guides Everything We Do
Integrity
Transparent and accountable in everything — every resource used responsibly and with purpose.
Compassion
Every decision made with the wellbeing of children and families placed at the very center.
Respect
Honoring the dignity of every child, every family, and every community we are privileged to serve.
Impact
Committed to sustainable, lasting change — not just temporary relief, but transformed futures.
Will You Answer the Call?
Somewhere in Sierra Leone Tonight, a Child Is Waiting for Hope
Supporters, partners, and donors become part of a global family
committed to protecting children and restoring hope where it has been lost.
Each contribution helps provide school materials, meals, medical treatment,
and a safe environment for children to grow with confidence and dignity.
When you support Pandie Foundation, you are not just giving money.
You are stepping into the role that Pandie Grace Bangura
continues to embody every single day —
a protector, a provider, and an unshakable source of hope.
Donate Now — Change a Life
Get Involved
"Pandie Foundation — The Mother of All — stands for compassion without boundaries and hope without limits."
stories: These are not statistics. These are children with names, voices, dreams — and futures that changed because someone chose to care.
"I want to become a teacher one day."

Aminata loved school, but her mother struggled to afford books, supplies, and basic daily needs. Some days she went to class worried she might have to stop. Through Pandie Foundation, she received school supplies, support, and the confidence to keep going. Today she sits in class with renewed hope — and a dream.
I want to become a teacher one day.
Aminata loved school but her mother couldn't afford supplies. With Pandie's support she received books, uniforms, and renewed confidence to keep going.
Now I can think clearly in class.
Musa came to school hungry every day. The feeding program gave him daily meals and transformed his ability to concentrate and learn.
I raised my hand in class for the first time.
Hawa was determined but lacked materials. Books, supplies, and encouragement from Pandie gave her the confidence to participate fully.
A preventable illness kept Mariama home for weeks. Medical assistance through Pandie got her treated and back in the classroom.
Ibrahim faced neglect at home. The protection program gave him safety, support, and adults who showed up consistently for him.
I have what I need now.
Basic supplies — a school bag, pencils, a uniform — changed how Kadiatu felt walking into school every single morning.
Your donation writes the next chapter for a child in Sierra Leone.

getInvolved: Every person who joins this mission — as a donor, volunteer, partner, or advocate — becomes part of a family that refuses to look away from a child in need.
Give financially — one-time or monthly — and directly fund education, nutrition, medical care, and protection for children in Sierra Leone.
Commit to one child's journey. Your monthly support provides stability, dignity, and a future they can believe in.
Companies and organizations can partner with Pandie Foundation for CSR campaigns, co-branded events, and impact reporting.
Offer your time, skills, or professional expertise — remotely or in person — to strengthen our mission and operations.
Share our mission on social media, with your community, or with your employer. Awareness creates donors and donors save lives.
Align your brand with a cause that matters. Employee giving programs, matching gifts, and sponsorships all welcome.
You don't need to be wealthy to make a difference. You just need to care. Whatever you can give — time, money, voice, or skill — it matters more than you know.
donate: The fact that you came here — ready to give — already means more to us than you can imagine. Our online donation page is being built right now to make sure every gift reaches a child safely and securely.
Online giving will open very soon. Until then, if your heart is leading you to help a child today, we would be so honored to hear from you directly.
Tell us how you'd like to help — one-time gift, monthly sponsorship, or sponsoring a specific child — and our team will personally guide you through it.
"Every child reached, every meal served, every life lifted — it all begins with a heart like yours that chose to care."
